note: Both sets hallucinate the same non-existent quote '3%, 5%, and 6%' and therefore both report the first edgewise damping as 5% when the page states 3%, 3%, 6% for flapwise, edgewise and torsional. Set A adds further problems: it misbinds the flatback rule (the trailing edge, not the normalized arc length position, is defined as the midpoint of the flatback surface) and repeats the damping and s-coordinate claims several times. Set B keeps the flatback trailing-edge definition correctly bound and includes the s = 0 / s = 1 figure annotations with clear conditions, with less duplication. Set B is therefore the cleaner and more faithful set, though both share the same damping error.
